description: Introduce a pluggable vocational-method registry and implement two NEW fully-interactive, self-scored instruments — CHASIDE and TIPOV — as pure scoring engines with their own item banks, response scales, and interpretation. RIASEC becomes one method behind the abstraction WITHOUT changing its existing engine code, types, seed, or tests. This feature is engine/data + unit tests only; no UI/DB wiring (that is FEAT-003).
steps: Create web/lib/methods/types.ts defining the generic pluggable-method contract. Design it so RIASEC fits without altering web/lib/riasec/*. Suggested shape: a MethodId union type 'RIASEC' | 'CHASIDE' | 'TIPOV'; an interface MethodDimension { code: string; title: string; shortDesc?: string; color?: string }; an interface MethodQuestion { id: number; dimension: string; text: string; category?: string; subScale?: string } where category/subScale supports CHASIDE's dual Interés/Aptitud items; a ResponseScale descriptor { kind: 'LIKERT_5' | 'LIKERT_3' | 'DICHOTOMOUS' ; options: Array<{ value: number; label: string }> }; a generic MethodDimensionScore { code: string; title: string; value: number; raw?: number } and a MethodResult { methodId: MethodId; dimensionScores: MethodDimensionScore[]; dominantCodes: string[]; dominantSummary: string; interpretation: string }. Define a VocationalMethod interface { id, name (Spanish), shortDescription (Spanish), origin (Spanish), dimensions, questions, scale, score(answers): MethodResult }. All user-facing strings in Spanish.

Create web/lib/methods/chaside/engine.ts and web/lib/methods/chaside/data.ts implementing CHASIDE per skills/knowledge/metodo-chaside.md. Read that doc for the exact 7 areas via the acronym C,H,A,S,I,D,E: C=Administrativo-Contable, H=Humanísticas/Sociales/Jurídicas, A=Artísticas, S=Medicina/Salud, I=Ingeniería/Enseñanzas Técnicas, D=Defensa/Seguridad, E=Ciencias Exactas/Orgánicas. Response scale is DICHOTOMOUS 'Sí'(1)/'No'(0). The FULL classic instrument is 98 items = 70 Interés (10 per area) + 28 Aptitud (4 per area). The doc does NOT contain the verbatim item bank, so author a FAITHFUL item bank: implement the complete 98-item structure (10 Interés + 4 Aptitud per area) with original Spanish items consistent with each area's described intereses/aptitudes; each item tagged with its area (C/H/A/S/I/D/E) and category ('INTERES' | 'APTITUD'). Add a code-level comment stating the item wording is an original faithful adaptation (the source doc gives the structure/scoring, not the verbatim items). SCORING (per doc): count 'Sí' answers per area SEPARATELY for Interés and Aptitud (Interés area max 10, Aptitud area max 4); the profile is formed by the TWO highest-scoring areas in EACH dimension. Produce a MethodResult whose dimensionScores expose, per area, the Interés count and Aptitud count (e.g. value normalized 0-100 for display plus raw counts), dominantCodes = the top-2 Interés areas (and expose top-2 Aptitud in interpretation), and a Spanish interpretation naming the dominant Interés areas + noting Interés-vs-Aptitud alignment. Keep functions pure.

Create web/lib/methods/tipov/engine.ts and web/lib/methods/tipov/data.ts implementing TIPOV per skills/knowledge/test-tipov.md. 13 interest dimensions: Tecnología, Empresa, Cálculo, Arte, Ciencias Sociales, Música y Artes Escénicas, Comunicación, Humanidades, Idiomas, Naturaleza, Salud, Leyes, Ciencias Básicas. Response scale LIKERT_3: 'Me agrada'(3) / 'Me es indiferente'(2) / 'Me desagrada'(1). Full instrument is 66 items across 13 dimensions (roughly 5 per dimension). The doc gives one example item per dimension but not the full bank; author a FAITHFUL item bank of 66 original Spanish items (5 per dimension, one dimension gets 6 to total 66; use the doc's example item as the seed item for each dimension) tagged with dimension. Add a code comment noting the items are an original faithful adaptation. SCORING (per doc): sum the raw values per dimension; higher = more interest. dimensionScores: raw sum plus a normalized 0-100 value (raw / (3*itemCount) * 100) for display; dominantCodes = top dimensions by raw sum; Spanish interpretation naming the top interest areas. Keep functions pure.

Create web/lib/methods/riasec-adapter.ts that wraps the EXISTING web/lib/riasec/engine.ts + web/lib/riasec/types.ts + web/data/seed.ts QUESTIONS as a VocationalMethod (id 'RIASEC', LIKERT_5 scale, 6 dimensions from DIMENSION_META, score() delegating to calculateScores/getDominantCode/getDominantProfileDescription). Do NOT modify riasec/engine.ts, riasec/types.ts, or the RIASEC portions of seed.ts. The adapter must produce a MethodResult that carries the same 6 RIASEC dimension scores so downstream code can treat all methods uniformly, while RIASEC-specific persistence (r/i/a/s/e/c columns) can still read the underlying PsychometricScores.

Create web/lib/methods/registry.ts exporting a METHODS registry (Record<MethodId, VocationalMethod>), a DEFAULT_METHOD_ID = 'RIASEC', helpers getMethod(id) and listMethods(), and a normalizeMethodId(value): MethodId that defaults unknown/absent values to 'RIASEC'. This is the single source of truth for available methods.

Add Vitest tests that assert REAL scoring math (no stubs): web/tests/chaside-engine.test.ts (verify item bank shape: 7 areas, 10 Interés + 4 Aptitud each = 98 items; verify 'Sí' counting per area for a crafted answer set; verify the two-highest-per-dimension profile selection; verify an all-'No' set yields zero counts; verify interpretation mentions the dominant area) and web/tests/tipov-engine.test.ts (verify 66 items across 13 dimensions; verify per-dimension raw sum for a crafted answer set; verify normalized value = raw/(3*count)*100; verify top-dimension selection; verify all-'Me desagrada' vs all-'Me agrada' extremes). Also add web/tests/method-registry.test.ts (registry contains RIASEC+CHASIDE+TIPOV, DEFAULT is RIASEC, normalizeMethodId falls back to RIASEC for unknown input, RIASEC adapter score() reproduces the same dimension values as calling calculateScores directly on the same answers).
Run typecheck, lint, and the full test suite. Confirm web/tests/engine.test.ts (RIASEC) still passes UNCHANGED.
acceptance_criteria: web/lib/riasec/engine.ts, web/lib/riasec/types.ts, and the RIASEC data in web/data/seed.ts are unchanged in behavior; web/tests/engine.test.ts passes unmodified
A method registry exists exposing RIASEC (default), CHASIDE, and TIPOV as VocationalMethod objects with dimensions, item bank, response scale, and pure score() function

CHASIDE engine implements 98 items (70 Interés 10/area + 28 Aptitud 4/area) over the 7 CHASIDE areas, dichotomous Sí/No, scoring by per-area 'Sí' counts with two-highest-per-dimension profile, per the doc
TIPOV engine implements 66 items over the 13 TIPOV dimensions, Likert-3 (3/2/1), scoring by per-dimension raw sum, per the doc
New Vitest tests for CHASIDE, TIPOV, and the registry assert real scoring math and pass; `npm run test -- --run` is green
`npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` pass
findings: Implemented engine/data + tests only (no UI/DB wiring, that is FEAT-003). Files created: web/lib/methods/types.ts (VocationalMethod contract, MethodId union, MethodQuestion with category/subScale, ResponseScale, MethodResult with optional raw payload, MethodAnswer{questionId,value}); web/lib/methods/chaside/{data.ts,engine.ts}; web/lib/methods/tipov/{data.ts,engine.ts}; web/lib/methods/riasec-adapter.ts; web/lib/methods/registry.ts. Tests: web/tests/chaside-engine.test.ts (10), web/tests/tipov-engine.test.ts (10), web/tests/method-registry.test.ts (5). CHASIDE: 98 items = per area C,H,A,S,I,D,E 10 INTERES + 4 APTITUD (ids 1..98, blocks of 14 in acronym order); dichotomous 1/0; scoring counts 'Si' separately per dimension (interes max10, aptitud max4), dominantCodes = top-2 interes, interpretation notes interes/aptitud alignment; normalized value = (interes+aptitud)/14*100. TIPOV: 66 items across 13 dimensions, 5 each with TECNOLOGIA holding 6 (ids 1..66); Likert-3 (3/2/1); scoring = raw sum per dimension, normalized = raw/(3*count)*100, dominantCodes = top-3 by raw. RIASEC adapter wraps existing engine/seed unchanged, delegates to calculateScores/getDominantCode/getDominantProfileDescription, exposes PsychometricScores in result.raw.scores. Registry: METHODS record, DEFAULT_METHOD_ID='RIASEC', getMethod/listMethods, normalizeMethodId (case-insensitive, falls back to RIASEC for unknown/absent). Verification: npm run typecheck OK, npm run lint OK (no warnings), npm run test -- --run OK (106 tests total, up from 81; +25 new), RIASEC engine.test.ts unchanged and green (20 tests). npm run build also succeeds with no env vars. No RIASEC engine/types/seed changes. Note: user-facing README update for method selection is part of FEAT-003 (UI/DB wiring), not this engine-only feature.
